text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $80k while Ethereum edges up slightly, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 73 and climbing indicates retail confidence, though Bitcoin's flat action despite rising sentiment hints at resistance—institutions may be cautious despite the greed signal. BTC dominance at 59.3% with modest altcoin divergence (SOL +3.1%, BNB -2.7%) points to selective positioning rather than broad risk-on, and the $69B daily volume is moderate, consistent with a wait-and-see market before the next directional move.
